$comment: Every framework and module the harness can install. A module's files are in modules/<category>/<module>/: all/ for every framework, <framework>/ for one; each is written at the same path in the project and merged with the project's edits. A module also brings: `scripts` and `frameworkScripts` (package.json), `checks` and `fileChecks` (what the hooks run, read from .claude/harness.json), `settings` (merged into .claude/settings.json), `mcpServers` (merged into .mcp.json), `install` (commands, each run when one of the paths it `creates` is missing; with none, every time), `mcp` (the .mcp.json servers its install adds), npm `devDependencies` and `frameworkDevDependencies`, and `audit` (the rule files and skill folders, at their paths in the project, that the audit skill checks existing code against). `required` modules are always installed, `auto` ones exactly when their `detect` matches (package.json fields, or `files` that exist), and exactly one `linter` module is. The setup skill suggests modules by `detect` and `recommended`, and asks about them by `category` (also the folder its files are in).
